memory_books_drafts_need_gen: draft needs generation | drafts need generation

memory_books_auto_create_desc: After enough new chat messages, create memory drafts automatically.
memory_books_auto_generate_desc: Immediately ask the selected model to fill new memory drafts.
memory_books_delayed_automation_desc: Wait for the assistant reply before creating memory drafts, so chat generation stays responsive.
memory_books_auto_create_lag_help: Keeps this many newest user/assistant messages out of auto-created memory drafts. Use 2-4 to safely edit or delete the latest exchange without regenerating memory.
memory_prompt_body_hint: Enter the complete generation prompt. Use {{history}} where chat history should be inserted.
memory_excerpting_auto_desc: If selected memories exceed the token budget, inject source-linked excerpts instead of whole entries. Turn off as a fallback.
memory_packing_full_desc: Use full memory entries only. Stable fallback, but can fit fewer memories.
memory_packing_hybrid_desc: Use full entries when they fit, then fill remaining budget with chronological excerpts from trimmed candidates.
memory_packing_chunk_first_desc: Always pack relevant chunks instead of full entries. Chunks stay grouped by memory and output in source chronology.
memory_excerpt_tokens_per_chunk_help: Upper bound for one injected Memory Book chunk. Smaller values create tighter fragments; larger values preserve more local context.
memory_excerpt_chunks_per_entry_help: Maximum number of chunks selected from each Memory Book entry before the global memory budget is applied.
memory_chunk_first_top_entries_help: In Chunks mode, the top N entries by score each receive at least one chunk before global ranking fills the rest. 0 disables this floor pass.
memory_chunk_first_top_chunks_help: How many best chunks to inject from each top-scored entry during the guaranteed floor pass, before global ranking fills the rest.
memory_mode_legacy_desc: Separate rollback path: legacy query, simple scoring, and top-N selection. It does not use modern catalog/entity/topic/emotion/salience enrichment.
memory_mode_fast_desc: Base modern deterministic selector: keyword and configured vector signals, modern ranking, filtering, and budget-aware packing.
memory_mode_balanced_desc: Everything in Fast, plus local catalog/entity/topic matches and available emotion/salience enrichment. No extra retrieval model call is made.
memory_mode_deep_desc: Currently equivalent to Balanced with the available capabilities. Reserved for deeper retrieval signals in the future; no retrieval LLM or reranker call is made.
memory_selector_advanced_desc: Controls how Memory Book entries are ranked, filtered, and packed into the prompt.
memory_selector_diversity_desc: Prefer memories from different messages/topics instead of many similar entries.
memory_selector_recency_desc: Boost entries created from newer chat messages.
memory_selector_recency_half_life_help: This is message distance, not real time. Glaze compares the memory entry's source message range with the current end of the chat. Example: 100 means an entry sourced about 100 messages ago keeps roughly half of the recency bonus; 300 messages ago keeps about a quarter. Entries without a source message range get no recency bonus. Relevance from keys, catalog matches, vectors, and importance can still beat recency.
memory_selector_importance_desc: Use each memory's importance score when ranking candidates.
memory_selector_exclude_visible_desc: Do not inject memories whose source messages are already in the current chat context.
memory_selector_continuity_guard_desc: If Balanced or Deep mode detects missing context but finds no reliable memory, add a short anti-hallucination guard to the prompt.
memory_selector_current_model_hint: Leave blank to use the current LLM model
memory_selector_query_assistant: Include assistant replies in search query
memory_selector_query_assistant_desc: Use recent assistant text together with user text when searching memories.
memory_selector_query_recent_turns_help: How many latest chat messages are used to build the memory search query. A turn here means one chat message, either user or assistant depending on the assistant-replies toggle. Higher values give more context but can make retrieval less focused.
memory_selector_query_max_chars_help: After collecting the recent turns, Glaze trims the search query to this many characters before keyword/vector lookup. Smaller values focus on the newest text; larger values include more surrounding context but may dilute the search.

block_prompt_helper_default: Sent in a system message to the LLM (main block rules)
block_template_helper: If set — model must fill content between tags. Empty field = keep the entire model response without XML parsing.
block_stream_sub_image: Agent HTML as LLM generates (before Image Gen)
block_stream_sub_js: Code from model as LLM generates (before sandbox)
block_stream_sub_default: Block text appears as LLM generates
block_static_html_helper: Bare HTML without <html>/<body>: rendered in sandboxed iframe. JS inside has access to window.glaze.* (setVariables, generateText, triggerGeneration, etc.).
block_llm_html_helper: Model must return HTML markup (can be in ```html```). If wrapped in ```html``` — the fence is removed automatically.
block_interactive_depends_sub: Receives output of the previous block as context
block_interactive_stream_sub: HTML from model appears in panel progressively
block_context_count_label: How many last chat messages to pass
block_context_count_helper: Counted from the message the block hangs on (not end of chat).
block_context_count_helper_full:
Counted from the message the block hangs on (not end of chat).
1 — only this message (assistant reply on panel).
2 — user+assistant, ending with this message.
4 — ~2 turns (2×U+A) before it.
0 — no chat log. -1 — all history up to this message.
block_previous_blocks_label: How many past outputs of this block to mix in
block_previous_blocks_helper:
Takes the last N saved outputs of the block with the same name from past messages and gives them to the model as context, to continue/update state rather than regenerate.
0 — disabled (default).
block_context_prompt_helper: Added to the user message before the chat log. Macros: {{char}}, {{user}}, {{description}}, {{personality}}
block_image_gen_help: Image Gen provider and key — in Settings → Image Gen. The block first calls the LLM agent, then renders the image by [IMG:GEN].
block_js_runner_help: LLM writes JavaScript from the prompt → code extracted from ```js``` → sandbox executes the script (context.messages, context.character, context.previousOutput). Result — return string or HTML.
block_interactive_help: The panel is rendered below the assistant message as a persistent sandboxed iframe island. JS code inside can call glaze.setVariables, glaze.generateText, glaze.injectPrompt, etc. Calls go through the same bridge as in other blocks.
memory_leave_blank_hint: Leave blank for current LLM model
chat_no_response_yet: No response yet — generate something first
chat_clear_confirm: Delete all messages? This cannot be undone.
onboarding_import_slide_desc: If you have a backup from SillyTavern or Glaze, you can restore it now.
onboarding_preset_slide_desc: Connect your AI now. Set up your endpoint and model.
onboarding_persona_slide_desc: Set up your profile. Characters will know you by this.
onboarding_layout_slide_desc: Choose how messages are displayed. You can change this anytime in settings.
onboarding_skip_confirm_desc: You can configure the API, persona, and chat layout later in settings. Skip the initial setup?
onboarding_allset_slide_desc: You've successfully configured Glaze. Press "Start" to dive into the world of roleplay!
onboarding_feature_roleplay_desc: Your perfect companion for roleplay. Forget complex settings — just open the app and start your story.
onboarding_feature_rules_desc: Connect to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint in a couple of clicks. Glaze never limits your API choice.
onboarding_feature_privacy_desc: Your secrets stay with you. All chats and characters are stored only on your device. No tracking.

ext_blocks_hint: Automatic info blocks and images after the model's reply.
studio_hint: Multi-agent pipeline that tracks state, cleans replies, and manages memory after each turn.
theme_built_in_empty_desc: Curated author themes will appear here.
theme_unsupported_file_type: Unsupported file type. Pick a .json or .thm theme file.
theme_confirm_delete_message: Are you sure you want to delete this theme?
theme_default_not_editable: Default theme cannot be edited. Import or create a new theme to customise.
theme_material_you_colors_locked: Material You uses your system colors. Colors can't be changed — only fonts and background/element effects.
theme_switch_to_bubble: Switch to Bubble layout to configure bubble colors.
theme_unsupported_image_format: Unsupported image format. Use GIF, JPEG, PNG, AVIF or WebP.
memory_books_waiting_for_messages: Waiting for {arg0} newer messages before creating a draft
memory_books_need_more_uncovered: Need more uncovered messages before creating a draft
memory_books_chat_generation_active: Chat generation is active — wait for it to finish before generating a memory draft
memory_books_messages_not_found: Messages not found for this draft
memory_books_setup_embedding_first: Set up embedding API in Embedding Settings first
ext_block_delete_confirm: The block will be deleted from the database. This cannot be undone.
post_building_no_chat_api: No chat API config available for the agent.
post_building_cleaner_subtitle: Rewrites the generated response to remove cliches.
post_building_cleaner_enable_desc: After generation, silently rewrites the response to remove cliches and repetition. Original preserved as a swipe.
post_building_cleaner_continuity_desc: Includes recent chat history in the cleaner prompt for local continuity checks: who said what, positions, clothing, recent actions. No extra LLM call.
post_building_cleaner_audit_desc: Opt-in. A diagnostic auxiliary pass checks the response against character card, persona, lorebooks, and memory. Returns contradictions that the cleaner then fixes.
post_building_cleaner_audit_model_desc: Overrides only the audit model. Endpoint, key, source, and protocol are inherited from the cleaner. Empty = use the cleaner's model.
post_building_cleaner_audit_model_no_end: Set the cleaner endpoint first — the audit inherits it.
post_building_cleaner_temperature_desc: Lower = more faithful rewrite, higher = more creative. 0.3 default.
post_building_cleaner_history_messages_d: Number of recent messages included for continuity checks.
post_building_cleaner_max_chars_per_mess: Each history message is trimmed to this many characters.
post_building_cleaner_banned_words_desc: Comma- or newline-separated words the cleaner must never use, even if the original has them.
post_building_cleaner_avoid_instructions: Specific patterns to steer away from (e.g. "no repetition of sentence structure from the last message").
post_building_cleaner_style_instructions: Style direction to lean into (e.g. "terse, hardboiled prose").
post_building_studio_section_desc: Controller + generator timeout before the first response chunk arrives.
post_building_studio_timeout_desc: Idle timeout before any text or reasoning chunk arrives. Once the model emits its first chunk, the timer is cancelled and the agent runs to completion. 0 = use per-agent defaults (final generator 90s, controllers 60s).
post_building_studio_max_tokens_desc: Token budget for the Main Responder. Increase for reasoning models (e.g. Gemini) that spend most of the budget on thinking and leave too little for the actual reply. 0 = use the agent default (8000).
post_building_studio_final_context_size_: Chat history messages for the Main Responder. 0 = use Studio default (15).
post_building_studio_temperature_desc: Temperature for the Main Responder. Raise for more creative/varied prose, lower for more deterministic outputs. Negative = use the agent default (0.8).
post_building_studio_disable_reasoning_d: Force-disables reasoning/thinking for the Main Responder regardless of the API config. Use with Gemini Flash thinking models that burn the token budget on a think-block and truncate the visible prose mid-sentence. Other models are unaffected.
post_building_studio_tracker_model_desc: Model id override for all 7 pre-gen controllers. Empty = each controller uses its own override or the chat's run model. A cheap fast model is usually enough — controllers emit compact JSON briefs, not prose.
post_building_studio_tracker_max_tokens_: Token budget for all 7 pre-gen controllers. 0 = use each agent's default (1600).
post_building_studio_tracker_context_siz: Chat history messages for all controllers. 0 = use each agent's default (5).
post_building_studio_tracker_temperature: Temperature for all 7 pre-gen controllers. Negative = use each agent's default (0.3).
post_building_studio_tracker_disable_rea: Force-disables reasoning/thinking for all 7 pre-gen controllers. Controllers emit compact JSON briefs, so a hidden think-block wastes tokens without improving the brief. Other models are unaffected.
studio_trackers_section_desc: 7 pre-gen controllers that analyze the scene and produce compact JSON briefs for the final generator. Run on a single shared model — a cheap fast model is usually enough.
studio_finalizer_section_desc: The Main Responder that writes the visible roleplay reply. Use a high-quality model here.
studio_finalizer_section_hint: Use a high-quality model — this writes the visible reply.
studio_trackers_section_hint: Use a cheap fast model — controllers emit compact JSON briefs.
post_building_model_hint_cleaner: Recommendation: use a high-quality model here — it rewrites the visible reply and catches prose issues. GLM / Sonnet or better.
post_building_model_hint_memory: Recommendation: an inexpensive model is enough — it writes compact memory entries and summaries. GLM / Sonnet.
post_building_model_hint_consolidation: Recommendation: an inexpensive model is enough — it merges existing memory entries. GLM / Sonnet.
post_building_cleaner_disable_reasoning_: Force-disables reasoning/thinking for the POST-cleaner LLM call. Use with Gemini Flash thinking models so the cleaner spends the rewrite budget on the cleaned text, not on a think-block. Does not affect the audit pass.
post_building_temperature_hint: Temperature (0.0–2.0). Leave empty = use agent default.
post_building_tokens_min: Tokens to allocate. Min: {arg0}. 0 = use agent default.
post_building_agent_timeout_desc: How long to wait for the auxiliary agent before giving up.
post_building_studio_ledger_enable_desc: Studio chats run Ledger automatically. Disabling this only affects non-Studio generations.
post_building_studio_ledger_model_hint: Extracts compact canon state after each final assistant response. Medium models are recommended. Cheap models may work, but bad output is rejected by schema validation and may reduce continuity.
post_building_studio_ledger_defaults_hin: Model: empty = inherit aux/chat model. Timeout: 0 = inherit aux timeout. Max tokens: 0 = use default structured-output budget (2000). Temperature: negative = use default 0.2.
post_building_studio_ledger_timeout_desc: Seconds to wait. 0 = inherit aux timeout.
post_building_cadence_studio_ledger_hint: Studio chats run Ledger every turn to preserve canon. This cadence only applies to standalone Ledger outside Studio.
post_building_cadence_low_warning: Lower cadence may delay MemoryBook writes and non-canon tracker updates.
post_building_cadence_block_next_desc: When true, block the next user-message generation until {arg0} finishes (or times out). Default false = fire-and-forget.
post_building_consolidation_enable_desc: Periodically merges memory entries past a threshold via an auxiliary LLM.
post_building_consolidation_threshold_de: Merge when entries exceed this count.
post_building_consolidation_timeout_desc: How long to wait for the consolidation LLM.
post_building_consolidation_not_function: Not yet functional — consolidation service is implemented but not wired into the post-turn pipeline. Settings are preserved for when it ships.

tokenizer_near_limit_body.one: Hide about {} top message to free about {} tokens.
tokenizer_near_limit_body.other: Hide about {} top messages to free about {} tokens.

post_building_recovery_desc: Re-run Studio controllers for every assistant message in this session. Use when Studio Ledger values were lost.
post_building_recovery_confirm: This will re-run the Studio controller cycle for every assistant message in the session. It may take a while depending on the number of messages. Continue?
rewrite_no_sessions: Start a chat with this character before requesting a rewrite.
rewrite_load_failed: The rewrite review could not be loaded.
rewrite_not_found: This rewrite job no longer exists.
rewrite_apply_confirm_body: All approved changes are applied together. This cannot be partially applied.
rewrite_block_loading: Loading the current card before approval.
rewrite_btn_approve_disabled_lock: A manual canon control protects this change.
rewrite_btn_approve_disabled_invalid: This proposal no longer matches the current card.
rewrite_invalid_snapshot: This saved proposal cannot be read.
rewrite_anchor_ambiguous: The anchor appears more than once in the current card.
rewrite_anchor_missing: The anchor is no longer present in the current card.
rewrite_evidence_immutable_note: Evidence is saved with this operation and cannot be changed here.
rewrite_generating_hint: The proposal is being generated. You can cancel it.
rewrite_failed_hint: Generation stopped. Retry the saved request or cancel it.
rewrite_regenerate_hint: Discard this unapplied proposal and generate a fresh one from the current evidence.
rewrite_cancel_requested: Cancellation requested. Waiting for the saved job status.
rewrite_delete_patch_confirm_body: Only this proposed replacement will be removed. The other patches in the same card field remain available.
studio_ledger_prompt_injection_gap_fille: Injects committed Ledger facts only after their source is no longer covered by visible chat history.
studio_ledger_prompt_injection_legacy_de: Injects relevant committed Ledger facts immediately, even while their source is still visible in chat history.
studio_confirm_delete_folder: Delete "{}"? Its prompt blocks will remain.
studio_agent_fixed_hint: These instructions are fixed and cannot be edited.
studio_post_context_desc: How many chat messages the post-processing agents receive (last turn + the response to edit).
studio_slots_hint: Set API connection and model each agent uses. Everything is optional - an empty slot falls back to the connection selected in LLM tab.
studio_slot_pregen_desc: All pre-generation controllers. They run as one batched request, so they share a single connection.
studio_slot_final_desc: Writes the visible reply — put a high-quality model here.
studio_slot_cleaner_desc: Post Clean: audits the reply, then rewrites it.
studio_slot_ledger_desc: Maintains the Studio Ledger (session state). When left empty, it uses the post-processing slot.
studio_slot_audit_model_desc: Runs the fact-check pass before the rewrite. Empty = the same model as the rewrite.
studio_slot_parameters_desc: Temperature, sampling, reasoning and extra request fields
studio_slot_override_hint: A parameter is sent only while its override is on. Off, the request carries whatever the selected connection provides.
studio_slot_settings_request_reasoning_d: Ask the provider to generate native reasoning. Inline reasoning tags are parsed independently.
studio_slot_no_api: No API connection for this slot
studio_reasoning_tags_desc: Override the reasoning tag pair used by this preset's pipeline. Leave empty to use the API connection's tags.
studio_fact_checker_desc: Audits the reply for continuity errors before the rewrite. Tap to edit the audit prompt.
sort_manual_hint: Drag presets into any order you like. The order is kept when you switch to another sorting and back.
preset_folder_delete_confirm: Delete this folder? The presets in it won't be deleted.

preset_delete_many_confirm.one: Delete {} preset? This cannot be undone.
preset_delete_many_confirm.other: Delete {} presets? This cannot be undone.

api_delete_many_confirm.one: Delete {} connection? This cannot be undone.
api_delete_many_confirm.other: Delete {} connections? This cannot be undone.

agent_ops_card_rewriter_chat_only: Card Rewriter is available when Agent Ops is opened from the chat drawer.
agent_ops_regenerate_body: The exact saved before-state will be used to regenerate {commit}. The current commit is replaced only after the new response passes every integrity check.
agent_ops_reconciliation_busy: Another reconciliation is already running for this session.
agent_ops_regeneration_applied_dependenc: An applied Card Rewriter proposal depends on this reconciliation.
agent_ops_no_commits: No reconciliation commits recorded for this session.
agent_ops_no_responses: No durable reconciliation responses recorded yet.
agent_ops_exact_diff_unavailable: Exact before/after diff is unavailable for this legacy commit.
agent_ops_raw_response_unavailable: Raw response unavailable for this run.
agent_ops_collector_correct_body: Edit the JSON response. It will be parsed and validated against the original immutable Collector input.
agent_ops_collector_proposal_ready: Collector recovered and Card Rewriter proposal is ready.
agent_ops_collector_exact_unavailable: Exact prompt is unavailable or was truncated. Use response correction instead.
agent_ops_collector_evidence_changed: Collector evidence changed; recovery was not applied.
agent_ops_no_collector_runs: No Collector runs recorded for this session.
agent_ops_exact_retry_unavailable: Exact retry is unavailable because the original prompt was not retained intact.
agent_ops_legacy_details_unavailable: Request and response details are unavailable for this legacy run.
agent_ops_snapshots_empty:
No snapshots recorded yet for this session.

Each ledger run writes a per-message snapshot of the Studio Ledger state. Committed snapshots are the accepted base for the next generation; tentative ones are pending the next user turn. This view is read-only; reconciliation commits and regeneration live in the Reconciler tab.
agent_ops_ledger_injection_description: Live read-only projection from current canon and the current Studio final-writer window. This is not a captured request.
prompt_inspector_studio_open_chat: Open a chat to inspect Studio requests.
prompt_inspector_studio_empty: No captured Studio requests yet. Run a Studio generation, Ledger reconciliation, Collector, or Card Rewriter.
prompt_inspector_studio_truncated: This capture was truncated before storage.
prompt_inspector_studio_wire_json_note: Wire JSON is not captured yet. This is the sanitized, post-processed transport request observed before protocol encoding.
prompt_inspector_studio_legacy_no_call_i: This legacy capture has no stable call identity.
prompt_inspector_studio_no_response: No linked response or parser verdict is available.
rewrite_resume_unavailable: This legacy job does not contain enough request data to resume.
rewrite_resume_failed: Manual rewrite could not be resumed: {result}
card_rewriter_studio_correct_body: Edit the response. It will pass through the same parser and validation before the chain continues.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_not_eligibl: At least one user and one assistant message are required.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_busy: Card Rewriter is already running for this session.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_active_job: Review or close the current Card Rewriter proposal first.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_model_not_c: Choose a valid dedicated API preset and model.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_invalid_ope: Card patch no longer matches the current card: {error}
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_invalid_lor: Lorebook patch no longer matches the injected entry.
The lorebook model returned an invalid patch response.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_empty_propo: The model returned no patches despite the supplied evidence. Check the saved debug response.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_stale: The chat or Ledger changed while the snapshot was being prepared. Try again.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_too_large: The Card Rewriter snapshot exceeds its safe size limit.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_call_not_fo: The interrupted request no longer exists.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_not_failed: This writer chain is no longer waiting for recovery.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_not_frontie: Only the first unfinished request can be recovered.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_lease_lost: The recovery lease changed. Refresh and try again.
card_rewriter_studio_outcome_claim_missi: The interrupted writer chain no longer exists.
card_rewriter_studio_enabled_description: Collects Card Rewriter observations from successful Ledger reconciliation runs. Ledger and reconciliation are controlled by the active Studio preset.
card_rewriter_studio_ledger_required: Card Rewriter does not work without Studio Ledger and its reconciliation runs. Enable Ledger in the active Studio preset first.
card_rewriter_studio_rewrite_lorebook_de: Uses a separate model call only for lorebook entries injected into this session. Turn this off when you do not use lorebooks.
card_rewriter_studio_timeout_description: Idle timeout for each card or lorebook model call. Default: 180 seconds.
card_rewriter_studio_model_description: Uses a dedicated API preset. It never falls back to the chat model.
card_rewriter_studio_empty_uses_api_mode: Empty uses the selected API preset model.
card_rewriter_studio_interrupted_load_fa: Could not load interrupted writer chains.
card_rewriter_studio_no_interrupted: No writer chain is waiting for recovery.
card_rewriter_studio_no_calls: No Card Rewriter calls recorded yet.
card_rewriter_studio_raw_output_unavaila: Raw output unavailable for this stage.
card_rewriter_studio_legacy_stage_note: The exact prompt and earlier attempts are unavailable for this legacy stage record.
card_rewriter_studio_no_proposals: No automated Card Rewriter proposals yet.
card_rewriter_studio_no_response: No response was persisted for this request.
